title: Compact coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-source-comparisons]. The existing derived scalar-unit inverse-image mate is invertible; use its isomorphism, whose hom is literally that mate, to define the proper direct-image coefficient mate through the actual exact-pullback/derived-direct-image adjunctions. The compact-support scalar arrow is this proper mate after the canonical open extension coefficient comparison. The direct-image compositor is the right-adjoint conjugate of the exact inverse-image compositor; the open compositor is the unique left-adjoint comparison for inverse-image composition. Given a normalized proper/open interchange, the compact-support compositor is its proper image followed by these proper and open compositors.

Rewrite scalarSixPullHom backwards by thetaNormalization; the hom of theta is invertible. This proves scalarPull_isIso without choosing any unspecified scalar comparison.

The remaining compact coordinates are the existing definitions: asIso of this literal mate, the published exact/derived adjunction, its proper mate and open-extension paste, the adjoint compositors, and their pointwise compactification paste. Their bodies are unchanged.
